SuperCLI 如何核对 CLI 来源、安装方式、用途与维护情况，以及如何公开: How SuperCLI reviews CLI sources, installation methods, purposes, and maintenance, and publishes inclusion evidence.
我们希望减少从发现到安装的试错。: Less trial and error between discovery and installation.
公开原始来源、核验范围与待补信息，让每一次推荐都经得起追问。: We publish original sources, review scope, and missing information so every recommendation can be questioned.
来源说明维护方，核验说明查过什么。: Sources identify maintainers. Reviews show what was checked.
厂商官方与社区项目采用相同收录标准。标签不代表质量排名，也不代表本站获得厂商授权: Vendor and community tools follow the same inclusion standards. Labels are not quality rankings or vendor endorsements.
由产品或平台厂商直接维护的 CLI。: A CLI maintained directly by the product or platform vendor.
由独立作者、开源组织或社区维护，也包括项目自己的原版 CLI。: Maintained by independent authors, open-source organizations, or communities, including original project CLIs.
CLI，查原作者、维护者、官网或原始仓库。区分上游与镜像，避免同名工具混淆。: CLI. Check original authors, maintainers, websites, or repositories. Distinguish upstream projects from mirrors and namesakes.
可公开的依据：项目仓库、文档、收录 PR。: Public evidence: repositories, documentation, and inclusion pull requests.
安装方式与上游说明一致，避免失效地址。资料核对和安装实测分开记录；实测须注明环境: Installation methods must match upstream instructions and use valid links. Source reviews and installation tests are recorded separately; tests require an environment and version.
没运行过，不写“安装实测通过”。: No installation-test claim without actually running it.
说明适合解决什么任务，核对平台、依赖、账号和费用等关键前提。让用户知道装之前需要: Describe suitable tasks and check platform, dependency, account, and cost requirements so users know what to prepare.
用途具体，限制有来源，避免夸大能力。: Be specific about purpose and cite limitations without exaggeration.
关注公开文档、许可证、归档状态和更新时间。仓库推送不等于版本发布，缺失信息明确标: Check public documentation, licenses, archived status, and updates. Pushes are not releases; identify missing information explicitly.
Stars 是热度参考，不是质量门槛。: Stars indicate popularity, not an inclusion quality threshold.
记录维护者、核验时间、实际范围与依据。工具信息变化后应复核；用户可以通过原投稿或: Record maintainers, dates, scope, and evidence. Recheck changed information; users can report problems through submissions or correction forms.
核验记录对应当时的信息，不作永久保证。: Reviews describe information at a point in time, not a permanent guarantee.
有记录才展示，查到哪一步就写哪一步。: Show only recorded evidence and state exactly what was checked.
核对了文档、原始仓库或安装说明；不等于本站执行过安装。: Documentation, original repositories, or installation instructions were reviewed. This does not mean we installed the tool.
只有实际运行并记录环境、工具版本与依据时才使用该标记。: Used only when a tool was run and its environment, version, and evidence were recorded.
已有收录出处，但尚未整理专项核验记录。不会自动标成通过或不合格。: Inclusion evidence exists, but detailed reviews are pending. No automatic pass or fail is assigned.
历史目录的核验详情正在逐步补齐。当前核验入口会如实展示已有范围，不批量补发“已验: Historical reviews are being added gradually. Existing scope is displayed honestly; no blanket Verified labels are issued.
让目录的价值，来自透明与共同维护。: A directory built on transparency and shared maintenance.
PR 人工审核后合并，main 自动检查与发布。Scorecard: Pull requests receive human review before merging; main is checked and deployed automatically. Scorecard
提供仓库成熟度参考，不能替代 CLI 安装实测或安全审计。: provides repository maturity context, not a replacement for installation tests or security audits.
